name: Ghost Paste Relay
description: A hacker collective's paste relay has resurfaced on the lab network after a midnight migration. Scan 172.20.0.0/24, where challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199. Investigate the reachable service and recover the protected archive record.

tasks.name: Recover the relay archive
tasks.description: The collective's paste server is running on the lab network. Scan 172.20.0.0/24 (challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199), investigate the service you find, and recover the protected flag.
hints: Look over the information the relay makes available before you have an account.
A public handoff record contains account details that may be useful elsewhere in the service.
Use the handoff account to authenticate to the archive, then read its protected record.
